updates.title: Floods during SPM: states ready alternative centres
updates.body: Heavy rain has closed four schools in Terengganu for now, and about 200 SPM candidates there are staying in school hostels so they can still sit their papers. Kedah, Kelantan, Negeri Sembilan and Sarawak have named schools at flood risk and prepared alternative exam centres, with help to get candidates to their papers. If floods or cut roads affect you, tell your school or JPN at once, and check which centre you should go to.

updates.title: SPM written papers have started
updates.body: About 420,900 candidates began the SPM 2026 written papers on 23 November, and papers run until 17 December. New this year: the BM and English listening tests are held on the same day as their written papers, to cut absences. Be in your seat 20 minutes early, and check each paper's time on the official LP timetable.

updates.title: Floods: help for SPM candidates at relief centres
updates.body: Some families in Hilir Perak have been moved to flood relief centres, and SPM candidates there are finding it hard to revise. KPM says academic support teams can be sent to relief centres to help candidates, candidates on islands off Terengganu will stay at residential schools on the mainland, and pupils in high-risk areas can be moved to school hostels before their papers. If floods affect you, tell your school or JPN early so you still sit every paper.

updates.title: Exams board: no leak in the SPM English speaking test
updates.body: Lembaga Peperiksaan said last week that social media claims about the SPM English speaking test questions were not true. It explained that a theme or keyword looking similar to the real task does not mean the questions were out, because one theme can be turned into many different questions. Ignore viral 'exam papers' and revise the whole topic list instead, like the prediction sets on this site.

updates.title: Floods: KPM's Op Payung plan for SPM candidates
updates.body: KPM said this week it is ready to activate Op Payung, its standard plan for running exams during disasters such as floods. Candidates living in flood-risk areas can be placed in school hostels before their papers so they still reach the exam centre, and teams are monitoring the situation with APM, PDRM and ATM. If floods affect you, report to your school or state education department (JPN) quickly.

updates.title: Monsoon season: plan for rain during exams
updates.body: MKN says the Northeast Monsoon started on 27 October and runs until March 2027. MetMalaysia expects 3 to 5 spells of heavy, continuous rain from November to January, mainly on the east coast of the Peninsula, western Sarawak and northern and eastern Sabah. That overlaps the SPM and STPM papers, so plan your route to the exam centre early, follow MetMalaysia warnings (myCuaca app), and tell your school straight away if floods stop you getting there.

updates.title: SPM English speaking test starts today
updates.body: The English Speaking Test (1119/3) runs from today, 2 November, to 5 November. The BM speaking test finished on 29 October, and STAM 2026 ends today. Bring your IC and printed Pernyataan Pendaftaran Peperiksaan; missing the speaking test counts as absent for that subject. Next: science practicals from 16 November, STPM Semester 3 from 17 November and SPM written papers from 23 November.

updates.title: Budget 2027: living allowance for Form Six students
updates.body: The government will give Form Six (STPM) students a living allowance at the same rate as matriculation students, expected to help about 90,000 students. Payment dates and conditions have not been announced yet, so watch for KPM's official notice.

updates.title: SPM 2026 starts on Monday with the BM speaking test
updates.body: Ujian Bertutur Bahasa Melayu (1103/3) runs from 26 to 29 October. The English speaking test follows on 2 to 5 November. Written papers start on 23 November.

updates.title: STPM Semester 3 starts on 17 November
updates.body: The first paper is Pengajian Am 3 (900/3) at 8.00 am. The last paper is on 26 November.

updates.title: STAM 2026 is under way
updates.body: 4,291 candidates are sitting STAM at 131 centres, from 12 October to 2 November.

updates.title: Flood season: exams still go ahead
updates.body: JKM Kelantan says it is preparing so that SPM and STPM candidates at schools used as flood relief centres are not disrupted. Candidates affected by floods should contact their school straight away.
